About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

  • Role Overview

    We are seeking an analytical, precise, and highly articulate Lead Quality Analyst (Medical Scribing & Transcription) with 5-8 years of experience to spearhead the quality framework for our healthcare data operations. In this role, you will be the ultimate gatekeeper of quality, bridging the gap between AI-generated outputs and human clinical precision.

    You will be responsible for executing advanced audits across two distinct workflows (AI-assisted Medical Scribing and Verbatim Medical Transcription etc), interpreting complex data evaluation matrics (Precision, Recall, F1-Score), communicating directly with clients, and driving the production team toward zero-defect delivery through rigorous feedback.

    Key Responsibilities

    1. Advanced Quality Auditing & Governance

  • Scribing Audits: Critically evaluate AI-generated clinical summaries against audios. Verify that all complex diagnostic data, treatment plans, and clinical nuances are perfectly captured, and that the final output meets strict professional medical documentation standards.
  • Transcription Audits: Perform precise quality checks on verbatim transcripts to ensure strict compliance with formatting guidelines:
  • Validation of audio segmentation boundaries
  • Verification of exact speaker attribution (Diarization).
  • Verification of context-driven punctuation rules.
  • Performance Driving: Transform audit data into targeted coaching, error-analysis reports, and feedback loops that actively drive the production team to improve throughput and accuracy.

  • 2. Metrics Analytics & Insight Generation

  • Data Interpretation: Master and utilize data science metrics including Precision, Recall, and F1-Scores to evaluate both human and AI performance.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Deep-dive into quality dips, identify systematic errors (e.g., misdiagnoses vs. segmentation errors), and execute targeted corrective action plans.
  • Performance Reporting: Compile, analyze, and present weekly/monthly quality dashboards and throughput reports for senior management.
  • Client Communication: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the client regarding quality metrics. Lead calibration calls, interpret client feedback, and align auditing standards with client expectations.
  • Guideline Calibrations: Proactively identify ambiguities in client transcription/scribing guidelines, seek clarification, and standardize internal calibration manuals for the team.

  • Required Skills & Technical Expertise

  • Clinical Accuracy: Exceptional medical terminology knowledge across multiple specialties (Pharmacology, Anatomy, Lab values, and Chronic disease management).
  • Analytical Mindset: Expert understanding of data evaluation frameworks. Ability to interpret how a drop in Recallaffects clinical completeness versus how a drop in Precision affects noise in data.
  • Acoustic & Language Skills: High proficiency in understanding diverse global accents (particularly US/UK English) and excellent command over formal, written English grammar.
  • Quality Mentorship: Strong capability to deliver firm, objective, and constructive feedback to production staff, driving accountability across the floor.

  • Educational Qualifications & Experience

    Minimum Education:

  • B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Nursing, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences.
  • B.Pharm / M.Pharm (Bachelor/Master of Pharmacy).
  • BAMS / BHMS / BDS (Alternative Medicine / Dental graduates looking for non-clinical corporate pathways).
  • Graduates in English Literature or general streams are acceptable ONLY if accompanied by a formal certification in Medical Transcription/Scribing.

  • Experience Profile:

  • Total Experience: 5 to 8 years in the Medical Transcription / Medical Scribing / Healthcare Documentation industry.
  • Relevant Experience: Minimum 3+ years of core experience acting as a Senior Quality Analyst (QA), Subject Matter Expert (SME), or Lead Auditor managing high-stakes healthcare data validation.
  • Prior experience working with AI-generated transcripts, digital scribes, or complex segmentation annotation is highly preferred.

  • 3. Client Interfacing & Guideline Management

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About Job

Job Requisition: Spanish Medical Transcriber

Job Title: Spanish Medical Transcriber
Department: Healthcare Language Services (HLS)
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time / Contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Spanish Medical Transcriber to transcribe healthcare-related audio recordings into accurate verbatim transcripts. The successful candidate will possess strong Spanish language proficiency, excellent listening skills, knowledge of medical terminology, and the ability to follow established transcription guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately transcribe Spanish medical consultations, dictations, and healthcare-related conversations.
  • Produce verbatim transcripts while preserving the original meaning and context of spoken content.
  • Correctly identify and label speakers throughout the transcript.
  • Ensure accurate segmentation, punctuation, formatting, and timestamping.
  • Apply transcription guidelines consistently and maintain high quality standards.
  • Accurately recognize and transcribe medical terminology and clinical language.
  • Review completed transcripts before submission to ensure quality and completeness.
  • Meet assigned productivity and turnaround time expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in Spanish.
  • Strong written communication skills in Spanish.
  • Experience in medical transcription, healthcare documentation, or healthcare language services preferred.
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, anatomy, medications, and clinical workflows.
  • Excellent attention to detail and listening comprehension skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet productivity targets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with healthcare transcription projects.
  • Understanding of speaker diarization and multi-speaker transcription.
  • Exposure to HIPAA/PHI handling requirements.
  • Experience working with transcription platforms and annotation tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Transcription accuracy
  • Speaker attribution accuracy
  • Adherence to transcription guidelines
  • Productivity targets
  • Quality audit scores

Skills

  • Spanish Language Proficiency
  • Medical Terminology
  • Transcription & Proofreading
  • Attention to Detail
  • Time Management
  • Quality Focus

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

Key Responsibilities

- Review and annotate image / video footage frame-by-frame or by segment according to defined labelling schemas

- Apply bounding boxes, tracking IDs, event tags, or classification labels to objects/actions within image / video content

- Edit, correct, and time-sync captions against audio/video content for accuracy

- Check captions for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and correct speaker attribution

- Ensure annotations and captions meet accuracy and quality benchmarks set by the project

- Flag ambiguous, unclear, or edge-case video/caption content for review/escalation

- Follow annotation and captioning guidelines and update work based on QA feedback

- Maintain productivity targets while meeting quality standards

- Attend briefings/training sessions on tool usage and annotation guidelines

- Report progress and issues to the Team Lead

Requirements

- Minimum Diploma in any discipline

- Prior experience in data annotation, captioning, subtitling, or content moderation is an advantage (not mandatory)

- Comfortable working with video annotation and caption-editing tools/platforms

- Strong attention to detail, especially for language/grammar accuracy in captions

- Able to follow structured guidelines and apply judgement on edge cases

- Computer literacy (navigating software tools, spreadsheets)

- Good written and spoken English skills (essential for caption editing)

Working Arrangements

- On-site (One North Area)

- Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

- Comfortable working with sensitive or varied video content as per project scope

###

### Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
